name: codegraph
description: Index any codebase into a graph database. Search by meaning, trace relationships, and get AI-powered context for your code.
long_description: CodeGraph indexes source code into a graph and exposes search, codebase, knowledge, and Cypher tools through MCP. Offline structural search works without API keys by setting the embedding provider to none.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find code by meaning using vector search and cross-encoder reranking

tools.name: codebase
tools.description: Manage codebase indexing: configure projects, reindex, check status, read source

tools.name: knowledge
tools.description: Store and recall project knowledge: entities, relationships, and facts

tools.name: query
tools.description: Execute raw Cypher queries against the code graph

project_paths.title: Project Directory
project_paths.description: Path to the codebase you want to index
